notes.title: Just Ski+ A Major Update to Just Ski
notes.content:
[h2]The Past[/h2]
It's been almost 3yrs now since "Just Ski" was first released on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/f4ac4ce5f5ced07e3425132c4db321830b50b010.gif[/img]
[i]Yee Haw! I'm on STEAM[/i]

Just Ski on Steam started as just an experiment for me.  Up until that point I had been primarily focused on mobile game development but always with one eye toward Steam.  Just Ski was my latest mobile game at the time and one day I decided to test the waters and release it on Steam.

I made some minor adjustments to the game to get it ready for Steam and released. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/65bca9d41d3129a9ed0671766f37acea1281ffad.png[/img]
[i]The original Just Ski start screen[/i]

The experiment went better than expected and I have not been back to mobile game development yet. Don't get me wrong, I will still release my games for mobile platforms, but they will be on Steam first and then ported to mobile rather than the other way around.

After Just Ski was released I made some minor bug fix updates and one medium size update that added the highly requested checkpoints to the game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/4f7d0e6073cd7340fa54e22ca9e6d30a2741e6a2.png[/img]
[i]I resisted these checkpoints for a LONG time. So glad I finally gave in.[/i]

[h2]The Present[/h2]
After the checkpoint update I let Just Ski just sit (like my play on words?) and moved on to start developing my next game, "Just Flip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/b4a9a956144b554641e4b950a1220c5c94ac9cf3.gif[/img]
[i]Testing some "Parkour Stones" in Just Flip. (Look for Just Flip to release in 2021)[/i]

To my surprise, Just Ski kept getting steady downloads and the reviews continued to be very positive.  I reached a point with "Just Flip" development where I needed to let it sit for a while and think about it's design.  In need of a distraction,  I decided it was time to give "Just Ski" a little love and a new name. :-)

[h3]"Just Ski" is now "Just Ski+"[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/fc6062e8139d40f783df39eb825089c8a7d7f617.jpg[/img]
[i]The new Just Ski+ start screen[/i]

This first release of Just Ski+ includes a major overhaul of the UI and a huge update (for me anyway) to the game graphics.  Not to mention a complete refactoring of the underlying code.

[h3]Here are some of the things that are new in Just Ski+[/h3]
[list]
[*] [h3]Updated the skier graphics (old on bottom, new on top)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/5efab17b2507bcfcf28f3e62190b2454d2ae1feb.gif[/img]
[*] [h3]New background and foreground graphics[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/55ad701de8cec1696223d0a653a5431225014827.jpg[/img]
[*] [h3]New Menu System[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/7deb67425be9f6915f38f6e59ffedafb87b9d08e.jpg[/img]
[*] [h3]New settings screen with ability to adjust mouse sensitivity[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/2bb852246095f178ea04dd286cd94bb1df8c54ce.jpg[/img]
[*] [h3]Updated the looping soundtrack with a longer version that has better quality sound.[/h3]
[*] [h3]New Steam capsules/logos for game.[/h3]
[/list]

[h2]The Future[/h2]
I've not thought to far into the future yet, but I do have loose plans to finally add  a new level or two.  Stay tuned for that.

I hope you enjoy this update, I put a lot of time into it.  If you do like it, and have not reviewed the game yet, please do. It's very, very helpful given how the Steam algorithm gods work.

notes.title: Checkpoints Release Now Available!
notes.content:
This is the 1st major update for Just Ski.

Just Ski is a difficult game.  So far, only 6% of players have completed it by making it to the cabin.

This update aims to increase that number by making things a bit more approachable for those that desire it. 

If you are already a master of the game then grab the update, turn off the checkpoints with a single click, and ski down to the end to checkout the new cabin scene.

See below for all the details.

[h1]Checkpoints[/h1]
With this update, when checkpoints are enabled, you will no longer be required to ski the entire course without a single crash.  Instead, there will be 3 checkpoints along the way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/4f7d0e6073cd7340fa54e22ca9e6d30a2741e6a2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/01e5e7624342c4b427a48cb5e2477c416d503f36.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/c9527ed29f226fe30d350f540fd58b8ecd39ca9e.png[/img]

If and when you crash and restart, you will respawn at the furthest checkpoint you passed. You now have no excuse for not getting to the cabin. 

[h1]How To Turn Checkpoints On/Off[/h1]
The checkpoint system is optional and can be very easily toggled on and off. Simply hit the checkpoint toggle button on the bottom of the main screen and ski.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/41c19a152d478648314867b95cb1549e85c7635c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Achievements and Flipping Stats Caveat[/h1]
There are some caveats to the checkpoint system.  I didn't want to make things too easy, so you won't be able to earn most the achievements when using checkpoints.  Checkpoints do not need to be disabled to earn achievements, but if you start off from a checkpoint, rather than the beginning of the course, you will not be eligible for achievements.

In addition to no achievements when starting from checkpoints, you also will not get any flipping stats for your run unless you start from the beginning.

[h1]Progress Indicator[/h1]
Lastly, I also added a progress indicator to the top left of the screen to show how far you have to go until the next checkpoint or the cabin depending on the situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/7c87acda77776d2f7f071a624309229ad9745f33.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/b187b6d77ed54e0ceeebb8aeca00823ac4bca8f4.jpg[/img]

I hope those that quit this game due to it's difficulty give it another go. 

Enjoy!

-Jeff

notes.title: Checkpoints Update Almost Ready
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31156058/de54589ba4a995ed0c6918f18a861c6affd15e4d.png[/img]
The checkpoint system is minimal and easy to turn on/off.  When on, you will see 3 checkpoints along the ski path. Crash after any one of them and the next time you reset you will spawn at the furthest checkpoint you have passed. 

You can toggle points on/off by simply hitting a toggle button on the main screen.

More soon...

notes.title: About Just Ski and Me
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31156058/7bda86efe20a29716ad20705f7c0143775ae3314.gif[/img]

[h1]About Me[/h1]
Hey everyone.  Just thought I'd introduce myself to those who find there way to this page.

My name is Jeff Weber and I've been developing physics games in my basement for 10-ish years.  I develop my games during my spare time and  currently, my spare time is down to about an hour a day so things tend to  move slowly but surely.

[h1]About Just Ski[/h1]
Just Ski is my latest physics game.  Like most of my [url=www.farseergames.com] games[/url] the control scheme for Just Ski comes from a very old, abandoned game called Ski Stunt Simulator.  I fell in love with the [url=http://www.cs.ubc.ca/~van/papers/2003-skigraph-skistunt.pdf] physics based control mechanic[/url] when I first played Ski Stunt Simulator and I've been obsessed with reproducing the controls in my games ever since.

Just Ski uses a somewhat simplified version of the Ski Stunt controls.  Where, Ski Stunt, allowed for mouse motion in 4 directions left, right, up, down, Just Ski uses just up/down.  I think you'll see that this still provides plenty of challenge. 

Just Ski will be my first game on Steam so I'm currently working to make sure I get everything as close to "right" as possible. 

One thing I want to be perfectly clear on, Just Ski has a steep learning curve.  It WILL frustrate you in the beginning (unless you've played Ski Stunt Simulator).  The game requires you lay down some new muscle memory, but once you do I think you'll enjoy the smooth flow of the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31156058/25f3bd8d833e7bcebeaa0e45e276f11b4e47be6b.gif[/img]

I look forward to hearing what people think of the game (good and/or bad).  

-Jeff
